title: Warm Smoky Norwegian Salmon Casserole
description: A smoky and molten Norwegian dish featuring salmon and mitsuba, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped mitsuba to the skillet and cook until wilted.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the spice mixture evenly over the salmon fillets.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place the salmon fillets in the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1-inch border around them.
Spoon the wilted mitsuba over the salmon fillets.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the mitsuba.
Fold the pastry border over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Place the casserole on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
